title: Xtreme Outdoor Products Recalls Climbing Sticks Due to Fall Hazard and Risk of Serious Injury
summary: The climbing sticks can break due to a bolt failure on the center step, posing a fall hazard and risk of serious injury. Units: About 1,165.

title: Apple Recalls Three-Prong Wall Plug Adapters Included in World Travel Adapter Kit Due to Risk of Electric Shock
summary: The three-prong AC wall plug adapters can break and expose the metal portion of the adapter, posing an electric shock risk. Units: About 814,000 (in addition, about 81,000 were sold in Canada).

title: Generation Brands Recalls Glass Pendant Light Fixtures Due to Risk of Injury
summary: The small glass pendant light fixtures can detach from their electrical cord, causing the fixture to fall unexpectedly, posing a risk of injury from impact. Units: About 1,200 (in addition, 30 units were sold in Canada).

title: Polaris Recalls Recreational Off Highway Vehicles Due to Crash Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: An incorrectly wired chassis harness can cause an incorrect throttle control signal to the electric drive motor, which can cause the vehicle to accelerate unexpectedly, posing a crash hazard. Units: About 3,900.

title: Polaris Recalls RZR Recreational Off-Highway Vehicles Due to Crash and Injury Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The brakes can fail, posing crash and injury hazards. Units: About 1,200.

title: H.E. Industrial Recalls Electric Garage Heaters Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The heating element can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 8,500.

title: Honeywell Recalls Gamewell-FCI and Notifier Photoelectric Smoke Sensors Sold with Fire Alarm Systems Due to Failure to Alert of a Fire
summary: The photoelectric smoke sensor can malfunction and cause the fire alarm system to fail to alert occupants in commercial buildings of a fire. Units: About 22,000.

title: Ranee's Recalls Women's Beach Cover-ups Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard
summary: The women's beach cover-up fails to meet the flammability standards for clothing textiles, posing a risk of burn injuries to consumers. Units: About 55.

title: Hunter Fan Recalls Brunswick Three and Four Light Ceiling Fans Due to Shock Hazard
summary: The light kit wires can be damaged, posing an electric shock hazard to the consumer. Units: About 7,800.

title: Home Meridian Recalls Corner Curio Cabinets Due to Tip-Over and Entrapment Hazards; Sold Exclusively at Havertys (Recall Alert)
summary: The recalled curio cabinets are unstable if they are not anchored to the wall, posing serious tip-over and entrapment hazards that can result in death or injuries to children. Units: About 520.

title: American Honda Recalls Recreational Off-Highway Vehicles Due to Crash and Injury Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The throttle pedal can stick in the open position, posing crash and injury hazards. Units: About 82,000.

title: Hayward Industries Recalls Pool Heater Vent Kits Due to Carbon Monoxide Poisoning Hazard
summary: The recalled vent kits installed on gas pool heaters are not the proper size and can allow carbon monoxide to leak, posing a CO poisoning hazard to consumers. Units: About 280 (in addition, 7 units were sold in Canada and 13 units were sold in Mexico).

title: Mares Recalls Buoyancy Compensation Vests Due to Drowning Hazard
summary: The deflation button can come unscrewed and result in loss of buoyancy, posing a drowning hazard. Units: About 600.

title: Amazon Recalls AmazonBasics Ceramic Space Heaters Due to Fire and Burn Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The heater can overheat, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 377,000 (About 18,000 sold in Canada and 3,765 in Mexico).

title: Cushy Form Recalls Folding Mattress Due to Violation of Federal Mattress Flammability Standard; Sold Exclusively at Amazon.com (Recall Alert)
summary: The mattress fails to meet the mandatory federal flammability standard for mattresses, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 2,300.

title: Target Recalls Toddler Boots Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The unicorn horn on the rain boot can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 29,000.

title: Yamaha Recalls Grizzly ATVs and Wolverine X2 ROVs Due to Incorrect Owner’s Manual (Recall Alert)
summary: Purchasers were given a defective owner's manual which shows the correct model on the cover, but the contents are for another model. Units: About 1,500.

title: Apple Recalls 15-Inch MacBook Pro Laptop Computers Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The batteries in the recalled laptop computers can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 432,000 (in addition, about 26,000 were sold in Canada).

title: BRP Recalls Coolers Due to Entrapment and Suffocation Hazards
summary: The cooler latch can automatically lock when the lid is closed, allowing a person to become locked inside the air tight container posing entrapment and suffocation hazards. Units: About 2,500.

title: Chandeliers Recalled by Dolan Northwest Due to Impact and Laceration Hazards
summary: The top loop of the fixture can bend and break causing the chandelier to fall, posing an impact and laceration hazard to consumers. Units: About 260.

title: Fisher-Price Recalls Inclined Sleeper Accessory Included with Ultra-Lite Day & Night Play Yards Due to Safety Concerns About Inclined Sleep Products
summary: Infant fatalities have been reported while using other inclined sleep products, after the infants rolled from their back to their stomach or side while unrestrained, or under other circumstances. Units: About 71,000.

title: Gillette Recalls Venus Simply3 Disposable Razors Due to Laceration and Injury Hazards
summary: A problem during manufacturing resulted in the misalignment of the blades in the razors, posing a higher risk of cuts during normal use. Units: About 87,000 (in addition, about 2,700 were sold in Canada).

title: Grandma's Fireworks Recalls Fireworks Due to Violation of Federal Standards; Explosion and Burn Hazards
summary: The recalled fireworks are overloaded with pyrotechnics intended to produce an audible effect, violating the federal regulatory standard for this product. Overloaded fireworks can result in a greater than expected explosion, posing explosion and burn hazards to consumers. Units: About 25,000.

summary: The recalled fireworks are overloaded with pyrotechnics intended to produce an audible effect, violating the federal regulatory standard for this product. Overloaded fireworks can result in a greater than expected explosion, posing explosion and burn hazards to consumers. Units: About 260.

summary: The recalled fireworks are overloaded with pyrotechnics intended to produce an audible effect, violating the federal regulatory requirements for this product. title: Patriot Pyrotechnics/Bill's Fireworks Recalls Fireworks Due to Violation of Federal Standards; Explosion and Burn Hazards; Sold Exclusively at Patriot Pyrotechnics
summary: The recalled fireworks are overloaded with pyrotechnics intended to produce an audible effect, violating the federal regulatory standard for this product. Overloaded fireworks can result in a greater than expected explosion, posing explosion and burn hazards to consumers. Units: About 11,000.

title: QTOP USA Recalls LED Work Light Replacement Bulbs Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The LED replacement bulbs can overheat due to an electrical malfunction, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 5,600.

title: West Marine Recalls Folding Deck Chairs Due to Fall and Injury Hazards
summary: The lock nut that connects the arm rest to the chair can loosen, posing fall and injury hazards to the user. Units: About 11,600.
